summary: Stage 4 implementation and executed local acceptance evidence pass review for this commit, with the collaborator own-login check explicitly retained as an open external gate (not run, not claimed). The serial driver validates all 23 calibration selections against frozen source document IDs or deployed journal IDs plus original payload hashes, requires exact per-event record equality (79 detector fields, 267 EPICS aliases, segment/damage maps) across all 60 original timestamps, enforces three steps of 19/20/21 via run.steps() plus a separate calibration-skipped flat pass, and fingerprints six calibrated JF samples, per-gain masks and two assembled images with dtype/shape included. The MPI driver aggregates world-rank records, rejects duplicate/missing/foreign timestamps and misassigned steps, checks topology and per-rank ordering, compares every raw JF fingerprint, and in the ninth case compares all six calibrated samples; all nine committed reports show status pass, aggregate counts 19/20/21 in both passes, returncode 0, and matching runtime module paths/hashes from the Stage 3 scratch install. The known encoder descriptions() TypeError is recorded only under narrow conditions and tested negatively; failed probes are retained as separate logs and not counted. No writes to XTC, calibration, or permissions; HTTP is guarded to GET, calib cache disabled, reports use exclusive-create. UCX unmatched tag-receive warnings appear in all nine MPI logs strictly after the PASS line and report save; they are a non-clean shutdown diagnostic, not evidence of event loss, but are not yet documented in README at this commit. Five low-severity, non-blocking findings concern documentation/provenance tightening only.

findings.evidence: All nine mpi/*.log files contain 6 or 12 'UCX WARN unexpected tag-receive descriptor ... was not matched' lines after the PASS line (e.g. n7-eb2-smd61-batch21-calib0.log lines 7-19), yet the 'Observations and limitations' section does not mention them. run_matrix.py line 21 passes '--mca btl self,vader', which does not govern the UCX pml actually in use per the log output.
findings.requested_change: Add an Observations bullet stating that UCX unmatched tag-receive warnings occur at MPI shutdown in every case, after the report was saved and PASS printed, with exit code 0 and all aggregate assertions satisfied; characterize as a non-clean shutdown diagnostic, not event loss, and note that the transport was the UCX pml (the btl selection did not apply). Reference the committed logs.

findings.evidence: The record stores psana.__file__ but not a hash or version of the collaborator's psana build or Python version. A calibrated digest mismatch under a different psana release would be indistinguishable in the report from an access or data problem.
findings.requested_change: Add psana module sha256 (or version string) and sys.version to the output record, and note in the README handoff that a 'Calibrated sample differs' failure under a different psana build should be treated as inconclusive for access and reported with the environment details rather than as a fixture failure.
